messages:
Leah M: heads-up: partner wants a single "plug-and-play" observability bundle for the HW marketplace listing (Datadog + OTEL). need final assets by EOD Friday.
Owen K: what exactly do they want bundled?
Leah M: OTEL collector example, minimal tail-sampling config, dashboard JSON, short ops blurb, and a 90s demo clip. also a one-paragraph legal-safe announcement line.
Samir J: on span attributes: they want model_name, batch_size, and quant_profile. big concern is quant_profile cardinality. suggest emit quant_profile only when != "fp16" and add model_family as a coarse tag.
Priya N: sampling: partner requests baseline 3% traces, with 100% capture for errors and latency > 450ms. OTEL tail_sampling handles that; i'll paste a tiny snippet to include in docs.
Priya N: snippet:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: error_policy
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: slow_policy
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 450
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Owen K: add note to index dd.trace_id on logs and index model_family not model_name. mention that quant_profile should be omitted from indexed fields.
Leah M: dashboard naming convention proposed: `Marketplace / <Partner> / Model / <model_family> / Inference` so tiles are consistent. Priya, can you include example Datadog query linking traces to metrics?
Priya N: example query: `avg:trace.inference.latency{model_family:resnet}.rollup(p95)`. also recommend storing trace_id in `dd.trace_id` field in structured logs for quick link.
Samir J: ops blurb: warn about collector disk use during high sampling. recommend logrotate sample and retention: traces 7d, metrics 30d. include command samples for `logrotate`.
notify-bot: Event created: 'Marketplace observability dry-run' Thurs 14:00 PT Attendees: Leah M, Owen K, Priya N, Samir J.
Leah M: i'll assemble the bundle after the dry run and open the marketplace PR. legal will review the announcement sentence post-PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
